text: They who lay the foundations of a State and furnish it with laws must... assume that all men are bad, and will always, when they have free field, give loose to their evil inclinations; and that if these for a while remain hidden, it is owing to some secret cause, which, from our having no contrary experience, we do not recognize at once, but which is afterwards revealed by Time, of whom we speak as the father of all truth.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
